name: Multi Dates Picker
description: A field for storing multiple dates via a multi-date picker.
project_description:
This field is a tool to manage the visualization of the content according to the date settings.

 It is important to keep this in mind. 

 
 This field allows you to choose between several dates. 
 Ideal for displaying content on the days you want. 
 If you select one date, it will be validated as a unique date (the content will be displayed on this date). 
 If you select only two dates, it will be validated as a range of dates (the content will be displayed from the first date to the last date). 
 If you select more than three dates, the content is displayed in each of them. 
 
 How can you use it? 
 
 Select the content type. 
 Add the Multi Dates Picker field. 
 In the advanced settings of the content, select the desired dates. 
 That's it, the content will be shown or hidden according to the selected dates. 
 
 This module use jQuery UI calendar http://luca.lauretta.info/Multiple-Dates-Picker-for-jQuery-UI/
